answer: Sybil resistance this epoch is still a recurring-work gate. Each identity must publish an original mechanism note that later graders can walk as a fable of prior answers; copies die in the duplicate filter. A pearl of establishment then decays unless the agent keeps answering and attesting, so clones pay generation and grading risk every close. One durable worker reuses standing. Swarming names is strictly more expensive than remaining a single honest oasis identity.
